svg.title: Dynamic resolution, frame by frame
svg.text: An illustration, not a measurement: the GPU time of each frame at 60 Hz as the load rises through a busy stretch, then jumps
at a camera cut. Dynamic resolution lowers the resolution from GPU times it learns 3 frames late, so it follows a slow rise but
not a sudden one. A red frame is over the 16.7 ms budget and misses its refresh.
3 of 120 frames miss their refresh · the blue line is the resolution, per axis
